name: Bright Sky
tagline: Free open German weather API wrapping DWD data with clean JSON
description: Bright Sky is a free open-source weather API that wraps German Weather Service (DWD) observational and forecast data into a simple, well-documented JSON HTTP interface for developers.

auth.details: No authentication required; public free API with no API key

use_cases: get current weather for coordinates in Germany
fetch hourly weather forecast from DWD data
look up nearby DWD weather stations
get historical weather observations for a location
